proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q hpq hset
  have hcl : IsClosed {x : ℝ | a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c ≤ 0} := isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  have hsub : Set.Ioo p q ⊆ {x : ℝ | a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c ≤ 0} := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← hset] at hx
    exact (show a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c < 0 from hx).le
  have hIcc : Set.Icc p q ⊆ {x : ℝ | a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c ≤ 0} := by
    rw [← closure_Ioo hpq.ne]
    exact closure_minimal hsub hcl
  have hp1 : a * p ^ 2 + b * p + c ≤ 0 := hIcc (Set.left_mem_Icc.2 hpq.le)
  have hq1 : a * q ^ 2 + b * q + c ≤ 0 := hIcc (Set.right_mem_Icc.2 hpq.le)
  have hp2 : ¬ a * p ^ 2 + b * p + c < 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 : p ∈ {x : ℝ | a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c < 0} := h
    rw [hset] at h1
    exact lt_irrefl _ h1.1
  have hq2 : ¬ a * q ^ 2 + b * q + c < 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 : q ∈ {x : ℝ | a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c < 0} := h
    rw [hset] at h1
    exact lt_irrefl _ h1.2
  have hp0 : a * p ^ 2 + b * p + c = 0 := le_antisymm hp1 (not_lt.1 hp2)
  have hq0 : a * q ^ 2 + b * q + c = 0 := le_antisymm hq1 (not_lt.1 hq2)
  have h1 : a * (p + q) + b = 0 := mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 hpq.ne) (by linear_combination hp0 - hq0 : (p - q) * (a * (p + q) + b) = (p - q) * 0)
  have hb : b = -a * (p + q) := by linarith
  have hc : c = a * p * q := by linear_combination hp0 - p * h1
  refine ⟨?_, hb, hc⟩
  have hm : (p + q) / 2 ∈ {x : ℝ | a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c < 0} := by
    rw [hset]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hm' : a * ((p + q) / 2) ^ 2 + b * ((p + q) / 2) + c < 0 := hm
  rw [hb, hc] at hm'
  by_contra hn
  have hn' : 0 ≤ -a := by linarith [not_lt.1 hn]
  have h2 := mul_nonneg hn' (sq_nonneg (q - p))
  nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (a b c p q : ℝ), p < q → {x : ℝ | a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c < 0} = Set.Ioo p q → 0 < a ∧ b = -a * (p + q) ∧ c = a * p * q
